module
public import tools.SharedCoverageInput
public import tools.DeferredCoverage
public import Std
@[expose] public section
open Lean

/- Research-only diffusion over existing original-payload hyperedges. This
module has no Work, Match, Union, completion, persistence or model interface. -/
namespace AdvisoryDiffusion

structure Graph (size : Nat) where
  edges : Array (Array (Fin size))
  postings : SharedCoverage.Deferred.Sparse.Incidence (fun id : Fin edges.size => edges[id].toList)

def prepare (size : Nat) (raw : Array (Array Nat)) : Except String (Graph size) := do
  let mut edges : Array (Array (Fin size)) := #[]
  let mut known : Std.HashSet (List Nat) := {}
  for members in raw do
    unless members.all (· < size) do throw "diffusion edge is outside the checked original domain"
    let canonical := ((Std.HashSet.ofArray members).toArray.qsort (· < ·)).toList
    if canonical.length < 2 || known.contains canonical then continue
    known := known.insert canonical
    let edge ← canonical.toArray.mapM fun id =>
      if bounded : id < size then pure (⟨id,bounded⟩ : Fin size)
      else throw "diffusion edge is outside the checked original domain"
    edges := edges.push edge
  return ⟨edges,SharedCoverage.Deferred.Sparse.incidence (fun id : Fin edges.size => edges[id].toList)⟩

def Graph.neighbours (graph : Graph size) (node : Fin size) : List (Fin graph.edges.size) :=
  graph.postings.lookup node

theorem incidence_complete (graph : Graph size) (node : Fin size) (edge : Fin graph.edges.size) :
    edge ∈ graph.neighbours node ↔ node ∈ graph.edges[edge].toList :=
  graph.postings.lookup_exact node edge

/-- Every edge endpoint remains a member of the original checked domain.
This is a bounds theorem, not a relevance or authority theorem. -/
theorem endpoint_bounded (graph : Graph size) (edge : Fin graph.edges.size)
    (position : Fin graph.edges[edge].size) : graph.edges[edge][position].val < size :=
  graph.edges[edge][position].isLt

def finite (value : Float) : Bool := !value.isNaN && !value.isInf

/-- A two-hop, degree-normalized walk on a payload/hyperedge bipartite graph.
Half the mass restarts at the unchanged query seeds. Isolated vertices hold
their mass. Fixed 32 steps; no data-fitted stopping threshold or coefficients. -/
def rank (graph : Graph size) (input : Array Float) : Except String (Array Float × Float) := do
  unless input.size == size && input.all (fun value => finite value && 0 ≤ value) do
    throw "invalid query seed mass"
  let mass : Float := input.foldl (· + ·) 0
  unless finite mass && 0 < mass do throw "empty or non-finite query seed population"
  let seeds := input.map (· / mass)
  let mut current := seeds
  let mut residual : Float := 0
  for _ in [:32] do
    let mut edgeMass := Array.replicate graph.edges.size (0 : Float)
    let mut next := seeds.map (· * 0.5)
    for node in List.finRange size do
      let adjacent := graph.neighbours node
      let outgoing := adjacent.length
      if outgoing == 0 then next := next.modify node.val (· + current[node.val]!*0.5)
      else
        let amount := current[node.val]!*0.5/outgoing.toFloat
        for edge in adjacent do edgeMass := edgeMass.modify edge.val (· + amount)
    for edge in [:graph.edges.size] do
      let members := graph.edges[edge]!
      let amount := edgeMass[edge]!/members.size.toFloat
      for member in members do next := next.modify member.val (· + amount)
    residual := (next.zip current).foldl (fun sum (a,b) => sum+(a-b).abs) 0
    unless next.all (fun value => finite value && 0 ≤ value) do throw "non-finite diffusion result"
    current := next
  let sum : Float := current.foldl (· + ·) 0
  unless (sum-1).abs < (1 : Float)/1000000000 do throw "floating diffusion mass check failed"
  return (current,residual)

/-- Change only the advisory objective. Original prerequisites, physical
costs, policy reservation and both wire limits remain those of the input. -/
def objective (raw : SharedCoverage.Input.RawProblem) (weights : Array Nat) :
    SharedCoverage.Input.RawProblem :=
  {raw with weights,offers := raw.offers.map fun offer => {offer with covers := offer.closure}}

theorem objective_keeps_costs (raw : SharedCoverage.Input.RawProblem) (weights : Array Nat) :
    (objective raw weights).costs = raw.costs ∧
    (objective raw weights).fixed = raw.fixed ∧
    (objective raw weights).limit = raw.limit := ⟨rfl,rfl,rfl⟩

theorem objective_keeps_prerequisites (raw : SharedCoverage.Input.RawProblem) (weights : Array Nat) :
    ((objective raw weights).offers.map (·.closure)) = raw.offers.map (·.closure) := by
  simp [objective,Array.map_map]

end AdvisoryDiffusion

AdvisoryDiffusionReplay.source:
import tools.research.AdvisoryDiffusion
import tools.VerifiedWinnerCoverage
import Lean.Data.Json.Parser
open Lean AdvisoryDiffusion
namespace AdvisoryDiffusionReplay
def check (condition : Bool) (message : String) : IO Unit := unless condition do throw (IO.userError message)
def read (path : System.FilePath) : IO Json := IO.FS.readFile path >>= (IO.ofExcept ∘ Json.parse)
def write (path : System.FilePath) (value : Json) : IO Unit := IO.FS.writeFile path value.compress

def fixtures : IO Unit := do
  let first ← IO.ofExcept (prepare 5 #[#[0,1],#[1,2]])
  let alias ← IO.ofExcept (prepare 5 #[#[1,0],#[1,2],#[2,1],#[0,1,1]])
  check (first.edges == alias.edges) "physical edge aliases changed the graph"
  check (!(prepare 2 #[#[0,2]]).isOk) "foreign original endpoint accepted"
  let (scores,_) ← IO.ofExcept (rank first #[1,0,0,0,0])
  let (duplicate,_) ← IO.ofExcept (rank alias #[1,0,0,0,0])
  check (scores == duplicate && (0 : Float) < scores[2]! && scores[3]! == 0 && scores[4]! == 0)
    "walk lost a two-hop connection or invented a disconnected source"
  let empty ← IO.ofExcept (prepare 2 #[])
  let (held,_) ← IO.ofExcept (rank empty #[3,1])
  check (held == #[0.75,0.25] && !(rank empty #[0,0]).isOk && !(rank empty #[1]).isOk)
    "isolated query or invalid seed handling changed"
  let small : SharedCoverage.Input.RawProblem := {
    costs := #[(1,1),(1,1),(1,1)],weights := #[1],fixed := (0,0),limit := (2,2),
    offers := #[{closure := [0,1],covers := [0]},{closure := [1,2],covers := [0]}]}
  let changed := objective small #[10,8,6]
  let p ← IO.ofExcept changed.decode
  let some chosen := SharedCoverage.choose? p | throw (IO.userError "independent selector fixture failed")
  let cost := SharedCoverage.cost p chosen.selected
  check (cost.1 ≤ 2 && cost.2 ≤ 2 && changed.offers.map (·.closure) == small.offers.map (·.closure))
    "diffusion bypassed original prerequisites or budget"

def run (directory output : System.FilePath) : IO Unit := do
  check (!(← output.pathExists)) "preserve the frozen diffusion replay"
  fixtures
  IO.FS.createDirAll output
  let mut reports := #[]
  -- All questions are selected and saved before a separate reference auditor
  -- opens frozen labels. Neither labels nor actual bodies enter this code.
  for topic in [1,2,3] do
    let name := if topic == 1 then "diagnostic" else s!"diagnostic-topic-{topic}"
    let input ← read (directory/name/"selection.json")
    let raw ← IO.ofExcept (fromJson? (α := SharedCoverage.Input.RawProblem) (input.getObjValD "selectorInput"))
    let witness := input.getObjValD "selectionWitness"
    let originals ← IO.ofExcept (witness.getObjValAs? (Array (Nat × Json)) "sourceNodes")
    let families ← IO.ofExcept (input.getObjValAs? Nat "families")
    let count ← IO.ofExcept (input.getObjValAs? Nat "candidateUnits")
    check (count ≤ raw.offers.size) "base unit population exceeds the frozen offers"
    let p ← IO.ofExcept raw.decode
    let mut frames := Std.HashSet.ofList (List.range families)
    let mut files : Std.HashSet String := {}
    for (node,key) in originals do
      let file := (key.getObjValD "file").compress
      if files.contains file then continue
      check (0 < node && node < raw.costs.size) "file payload lacks a valid preceding frame"
      frames := frames.insert (node-1)
      files := files.insert file
    check (originals.all fun (node,_) => !frames.contains node) "structural metadata overlaps an original payload"
    let started ← IO.monoMsNow
    let edges := raw.offers.map fun offer => (offer.closure.filter (!frames.contains ·)).toArray
    let graph ← IO.ofExcept (prepare raw.costs.size edges)
    let prepareMs := (← IO.monoMsNow)-started
    let mut cueNodes : Std.HashMap Nat (Std.HashSet Nat) := {}
    for offer in raw.offers[:count] do
      for cue in offer.covers do
        if cue%2 != 0 then continue
        let mut members := cueNodes[cue]?.getD {}
        for node in offer.closure do
          unless frames.contains node do members := members.insert node
        cueNodes := cueNodes.insert cue members
    let maximum := raw.weights.foldl max 0
    check (0 < maximum) "query has no original focus signal"
    let denominator := maximum.toFloat
    check (finite denominator) "query scale cannot be normalized without overflow"
    let mut seed := Array.replicate raw.costs.size (0 : Float)
    for cue in [:raw.weights.size] do
      let members := (cueNodes[cue]?.getD {}).toArray.qsort (· < ·)
      if members.isEmpty || raw.weights[cue]! == 0 then continue
      let amount := raw.weights[cue]!.toFloat/denominator/members.size.toFloat
      for node in members do seed := seed.modify node (· + amount)
    let started ← IO.monoMsNow
    let (scores,residual) ← IO.ofExcept (rank graph seed)
    let rankMs := (← IO.monoMsNow)-started
    let weights := scores.map fun value => (value*1125899906842624).toUInt64.toNat
    let candidate := objective raw weights
    let next ← IO.ofExcept candidate.decode
    check (candidate.costs == raw.costs && candidate.limit == raw.limit && candidate.fixed == raw.fixed &&
      candidate.offers.map (·.closure) == raw.offers.map (·.closure)) "original packet contract changed"
    let started ← IO.monoMsNow
    let some before := SharedCoverage.choose? p | throw (IO.userError "baseline replay is infeasible")
    let baselineMs := (← IO.monoMsNow)-started
    let expected ← IO.ofExcept (witness.getObjValAs? (List Nat) "compiledSelected")
    check (before.selected.map Fin.val == expected) "baseline does not reproduce the frozen actual selection"
    let started ← IO.monoMsNow
    let some chosen := SharedCoverage.choose? next | throw (IO.userError "diffused replay is infeasible")
    let selectMs := (← IO.monoMsNow)-started
    let nodes := (SharedCoverage.nodes next chosen.selected).map Fin.val
    let cost := SharedCoverage.cost next chosen.selected
    check (cost.1 ≤ raw.limit.1 && cost.2 ≤ raw.limit.2) "chosen evidence exceeds the original limits"
    let report := Json.mkObj [("topic",toJson topic),("selected",toJson (chosen.selected.map Fin.val)),
      ("selectedNodes",toJson nodes),("cost",toJson cost),("frames",toJson frames.size),
      ("vertices",toJson raw.costs.size),("edges",toJson graph.edges.size),
      ("incidences",toJson (graph.edges.foldl (fun total edge => total+edge.size) 0)),
      ("prepareMs",toJson prepareMs),("rankMs",toJson rankMs),("baselineMs",toJson baselineMs),
      ("selectionMs",toJson selectMs),("residualL1",toJson residual),
      ("baselineSelectionReproduced",toJson true),("labelsUsed",toJson false)]
    write (output/s!"topic-{topic}.json") report
    reports := reports.push report
  write (output/"result.json") (Json.mkObj [("topics",toJson reports),("restart",toJson (0.5 : Float)),
    ("steps",toJson (32 : Nat)),("weightScale",toJson (1125899906842624 : Nat)),
    ("actualHookDelivery",toJson false),("newModelCalls",toJson (0 : Nat)),("adopted",toJson false)])
end AdvisoryDiffusionReplay
